text: Bitcoin is holding steady above $63k with modest gains while Ethereum has slipped slightly, suggesting cautious sentiment between the two majors. The Fear & Greed index at 28 indicates sustained market anxiety, reinforced by a worsening trend over the past week. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 56.4% paired with modest $57B daily volume points to risk-off behavior, where investors are rotating toward the perceived safer major asset rather than deploying fresh capital broadly.
